proposals.title: Fossil fuel financing
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy by end of 2022 so financing does not contribute to new fossil fuel supplies inconsistent with the IEA Net Zero Emissions by 2050 Scenario.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Special shareholder meeting improvement
proposals.topic_summary: Amend governing documents so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting, replacing the current 20% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy requiring separation of Chairman and CEO roles, with an independent Chairman who was not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Board diversity resolution
proposals.topic_summary: Require initial lists of outside director candidates to include qualified diverse candidates and publish nominee skills matrices to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Conversion to public benefit corporation
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Amend certificate of incorporation and bylaws to convert the company into a public benefit corporation in light of the Business Roundtable Statement.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on setting absolute contraction targets
proposals.topic_summary: Issue a report setting absolute contraction targets for financed greenhouse gas emissions per UNEP FI recommendations for credible net zero commitments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
